issues.where: Core map, second line of each assembly (1 h change) and the rod/dropped-rod rings
issues.problem: In the zoomed views a lot of the 1 h change values can't be read. The faint '±0.000' cyan text vanishes on the bright Cherenkov-blue centre. The red and green values on the amber/orange hotspot at 34 s (e.g. '+0.073', '+0.065') have almost no contrast. Bright MC neutron tracks and their collision clumps run straight through the digits (e.g. '0.8̶46', '−0.0̶89'). In ringed assemblies the change value sits on the bottom border of the amber or red ring. This is the hero's tiny text, and the camera zooms in on exactly these cells.
issues.fix: Draw the per-assembly numbers last, above the tracks, with a 1 px dark halo or a 60 % navy backing chip behind each two-line label. Darken the change colours to #2FBF80 and #FF4A4A and make them bold. Clip the MC tracks to 50 % alpha inside the label boxes. Shift the ring label stack up 2 px, or pad the ring by 2 px so the bottom number clears the border.

issues.where: Monte Carlo panel, k-per-generation and Shannon-entropy charts (19 s frame)
issues.problem: A new MC run starts on every 2 sim-hour snapshot, so the charts reset about every 8 s. For a quarter of the video the k chart holds only ~54 generations bunched at the left of a 0–475 axis, with no σ band. The entropy trace is a stub too. The brief asks for a run several hundred active generations deep, with a tight band and flat entropy, at all times. Right now it reads as a half-empty chart.
issues.fix: Keep the previous run's points ghosted at 30 % alpha behind the new run, with its mean ± σ band still drawn. Or use a scrolling window of generations that runs across run boundaries with a vertical 'snapshot D4 00:00' divider. Or snapshot less often (every 6 sim-h) so the active cycles stay deep.

issues.where: Quadrant tilt chart (34 s and 50 s frames)
issues.problem: During the rod-drop excursion the quadrant-power chart shows only a single '1.00' tick. You can't read QPTR 1.51 or SW 0.47 off the chart, and the SW trace looks pushed off the bottom of the plot.
issues.fix: Autoscale with headroom to [min(SW)−0.05, max(QPTR)+0.05] and always label at least three ticks (e.g. 0.50 / 1.00 / 1.50). Keep the 1.02 limit line labelled.

issues.where: Core map, status bar and right column during the drop (34 s frame: QPTR 1.5084, F_xy 1.885 at 100 % power)
issues.problem: The model is internally consistent, but a reactor physicist will see QPTR 1.5 and F_xy 1.9 held at 100 % power with no protective response. Tech specs would force a power reduction above QPTR 1.02. The dropped rod's worth, which is what drives the tilt, isn't shown anywhere.
issues.fix: Add a red 'TS QPTR > 1.02 · ACTION: REDUCE POWER' alarm in the log and status bar. Either have the controller derate power (3 % per 1 % QPTR over 1.00) or label it 'no operator action (demo)'. Show the measured dropped-rod worth in pcm in the DROPPED ROD callout and the tilt readouts.

issues.where: Monte Carlo panel worker shares vs Compute plant WORKERS row
issues.problem: Each worker tracks 3,333 histories in about 4.8 ms, which works out to ~700k/s. The compute plant shows every worker at exactly '200k/s' in every frame, so it looks hard-coded. The 60 gen/s cap tied to the frame rate isn't explained.
issues.fix: Show the real per-worker rate (histories ÷ compute ms) with its live jitter, and add an 'idle/sync' share, e.g. '4.8 ms busy · 11.9 ms wait'. Or label the 1.20 M/s as 'frame-capped 60 gen/s'.

issues.where: Core map 1 h change values, quadrant readouts and Diffusion solver residual
issues.problem: Formatting glitches: negative zero ('−0.000', '1 h −0.0000') shows all over the steady-state map, and the residual appears as '10.0e-6' instead of '1.00e-5'.
issues.fix: Round first and print anything that rounds to zero as '0.000' (muted, no sign). Normalise the mantissa to [1, 10) before printing exponent notation.

issues.where: Rod-step kinetics, precursor bars and P(t) chart
issues.problem: All six precursor groups read 'C/C,eq 1.000' and the bars are identical in every frame, so that sub-panel looks frozen. The end-value labels ('1.2419', '0.8242', '1.4968') are drawn on top of the trace line.
issues.fix: Show C/C,eq over the 0–120 s response window (the value at 120 s, or a min–max whisker) so the bars move with each rod step. Or show it during the ramps, where it really departs from 1. Move the end-value label above or below the line's end with a small leader.

issues.where: Core map, x/y centre-line flux-profile strips (bottom and right edges)
issues.problem: The strips are only ~20 px deep and have no y-scale. φ1 and φ2 look nearly flat with edge bumps, so the centre peak and the E-W tilt are barely visible.
issues.fix: Give the profiles 36–40 px, add faint 0.5/1.0 gridlines, fill under φ1 at low alpha, and mark the dropped-rod column on the x-profile.

issues.problem: The worst main-thread frame costs 128 ms. If that lands during recording it shows up as a visible stutter, and the compute plant's frame-time trace sits flat on 16.7 ms, so it would hide the hitch.
issues.fix: Find the 128 ms frame (probably the log rebuild or chart re-render at the run or snapshot switch) and spread it across frames. Make sure it only happens before the 35 s warm-up ends, and plot the real JS cost per frame in the frame trace.

critic.summary:
This is very strong: a dense, coherent control-room cockpit that matches the brief closely, in the right palette, fonts and layout, and the physics holds up under checking. Every cross-check I ran agrees:
- ρ = (k−1)/k
- prompt jump β/(β−ρ) and ω = 1/period
- Tf mean and max from 583 + 600·q
- quadrant powers summing to 4.000 and F_xy equal to the hottest assembly
- field-map means equal to the xenon-panel atom densities, and I/Xe ≈ 7, close to equilibrium theory
- cell updates per solve = 15,424·6·outers
- histories/s matching the totals between frames
- CPU % equal to the mean of the 16 threads

The story plays out on camera: the ramp to 50 %, the red SW rod drop, a xenon-driven tilt that grows to QPTR 1.51 and then swings back, the Xe hotspot on the field map, and the xenon undershoot after the ramp back up. What keeps it from a 9–10 is the tiny text on the hero map, the thing the camera zooms in on: the change values have weak contrast and MC tracks run through the digits. Beyond that, the MC charts reset to nearly empty every ~8 s, the tilt chart has too few ticks during the excursion, there are a few formatting glitches (−0.000, 10.0e-6), and a reactor physicist would object to QPTR 1.5 at full power with no tech-spec response. Fix the label legibility and the MC reset and I would post it.
